references.source: mwg-eval C1 A r1 (button trigger, v-show card)

mutants.wrong: the card opens on hover only; keyboard focus on the avatar does nothing
mutants.violates: hovering or focusing ... should also work for keyboard users

mutants.wrong: the card shows name, title and last active but not location or email
mutants.violates: a small card with their name, title, location, email and when they were last active

mutants.wrong: the card leaves out when the user was last active
mutants.violates: and when they were last active

mutants.wrong: Escape does not dismiss the card
mutants.violates: it should also work for keyboard users

mutants.wrong: the trigger is a plain span, so Tab never reaches the avatar
mutants.violates: focusing a user's avatar should show the card; work for keyboard users

mutants.wrong: the card stays open after the pointer leaves
mutants.violates: hovering ... should show a small card (a hovercard, not a sticky panel)

mutants.wrong: a native title tooltip with name and email, no card
mutants.violates: a small card with their name, title, location, email and when they were last active
